Name: Sentry
Author: Rahul Chhabria

Actions.Name: Pulse
Actions.Tooltip: Flashes on genuinely new Sentry issues; short press acknowledges and selects; long press toggles mute.

Actions.Name: Inspect Issue
Actions.Tooltip: Short press opens the selected issue in Sentry. Long press opens its best source location in your configured IDE.

Actions.Name: Next Issue
Actions.Tooltip: Short press selects the next highest-pain unresolved issue; long press selects the previous issue (wraps).

Actions.Name: Agent
Actions.Tooltip: Sends the selected issue to your local coding agent via CLI. Long press explicitly asks for a draft PR.

Actions.Name: View PR
Actions.Tooltip: Opens the selected issue's PR and shows CI status. If no PR exists, asks the configured agent to validate local changes and create a draft PR.

Actions.Name: Resolve
Actions.Tooltip: Resolve (short) or archive (long) the selected issue via a two-press confirmation. Requires event:write.

Description: A 6-key human-in-the-loop pipeline for Sentry on a Stream Deck: NEW ISSUE / INSPECT / NEXT / AGENT / VIEW PR / RESOLVE. Navigate highest-pain issues, hand off to a local agent, follow draft PR status, and resolve/archive.
